title: Wrap-Around Pass vs Defender
description: A driver who meets a help defender wraps the ball around the defender's body to a teammate on the baseline — an advanced pass from drive situations.

content.objective: Pass around a stepping-up help defender to the open teammate behind them, using one hand and a tight wrap.
content.setup: Driver at the wing, a help defender at the block, a receiver in the short corner.
instructions: The driver attacks baseline toward the rim.
The help defender steps across to stop the drive.
The driver steps under or beside the defender and wraps the ball around their hip with one hand.
The short-corner receiver catches and finishes.
If the help does not come, the driver finishes.
coachingPoints: Two hands until the last moment, then one-hand wrap.
Pass low around the hip, not over the arms.
Read the help: no help, no pass.
commonMistakes: Wrapping the ball too early, so the help recovers.
content.safety: The help defender stands still or slides; no taking charges in this drill.
progressions: Live help defender who can choose to stay home.
Add a defender on the receiver.
regressions: Bounce pass instead of the wrap.
variations: Wrap from the middle drive to the weak-side dunker spot.
successCriteria: Correct decision (pass or finish) in 8 of 10 reps.
Pass reaches the receiver in a scoring position.
content.gameApplication: When help defense comes, the open player is right behind it; the wrap pass finds them.
